brief: A meal-kit startup wants to know why customers pause or cancel after the first month.
A bank is redesigning its mobile app and wants to learn how people in their 20s manage money day to day.
A sneaker brand wants to understand what makes runners over 50 choose or avoid a new running shoe.
A streaming service wants to learn why households share accounts and how they would feel about paying extra for it.
A coffee chain wants to know why office workers skip its loyalty app.
